name: REA-guided D3DMetal redesign wave 1
goal: Replace DXMT's queue-wide synchronization and per-surface replay assumptions with a D3DMetal-informed GPU work graph, then continue through bindings, tile lifetime, present/temporal, and shader/indirect execution without claiming FPS until a current-source runtime proves it.
success_criteria: Every harvest lane produces a bounded evidence handoff with observed facts, inferred design, exact source owners, risks, and one recommended next increment.
The main implementation increment preserves unknown/auxiliary fallback and passes clangd, git diff --check, and the focused diagnostics it affects.
A final verification node re-reads all producer handoffs and runs the real repository checks before the phase is reported complete.

nodes.task: Harvest auxiliary GPU work and dependency edge ownership for the next queue scheduler increment.
nodes.solutionSpace: unspecified-high: spans queue replay, encoder metadata, and internal helper work but is read-only.

nodes.task: Harvest persistent binding and tile-lifetime redesign candidates against current source and retained D3DMetal evidence.
nodes.solutionSpace: unspecified-high: spans command encoder metadata, descriptor ownership, render replay, and resolve/store semantics.

nodes.task: Harvest temporal/present and shader/indirect redesign candidates against current source and retained D3DMetal evidence.
nodes.solutionSpace: unspecified-high: spans temporal/present and compiler/indirect domains.

nodes.task: Read all three harvest handoffs, select one bounded implementation increment, and apply it only in the assigned source scope.
nodes.solutionSpace: deep-high: cross-component scheduling judgment must reconcile correctness, REA evidence, and shared dirty files.

nodes.task: Verify the integrated wave-1 source increment and all producer claims with repository diagnostics and focused tests.
nodes.solutionSpace: unspecified-high: runs the real checks and reports binary pass/fail evidence.
